searched: 2026-11-02. Read Anthropic's index https://www.anthropic.com/system-cards (HTTP 200; 22 rows, Claude 2 of July 2023 to Claude Haiku 5.5 of October 2026, each with a month and a 'Read system card' link; rows are not in strict date order: 'Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, June 2026' sits between Opus 4.8 (May 2026) and Opus 4.7 (April 2026)). Read the Transparency hub https://www.anthropic.com/transparency (HTTP 200) for further card links: it also links two other PDF addresses labelled as the Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 system card (www-cdn.anthropic.com/6be99a52….pdf and /6d8a8055….pdf), several addresses for the Claude Mythos Preview system card, and non-card documents (a 'Claude Mythos Preview Alignment Risk Update', an August 2026 Risk Report, RSP documents); these were not retrieved. Read the announcement pages for Claude (v1) (dated Mar 14, 2023), Claude Instant 1.2 (Aug 9, 2023) and Claude 2.1 (Nov 21, 2023); the Claude 2.1 page links a re-issued Claude 2 model card with a 'Claude 2.1 Model Card Appendix', which is not on the system-cards index. Searched data/sources.json titles for 'System Card' and 'Model Card': the dataset holds the July 2023 Claude 2 card (source-eval-i-claude2-card), the Claude 3.7 Sonnet card (source-ab-claude37-card) and the Claude Sonnet 4.5 card (source-ab-claude-sonnet45-card). Redirects of the four most recent index links were resolved with ranged requests (all to assets.claude.com PDFs). Dates below marked 'index month' are the month shown on the system-cards index on 2026-11-02; the card's own printed date was not checked unless the card was retrieved. web.archive.org was not tried.
